Question 14

Given the function f(x)=x2−3x+3x3 defined for x∈(0,∞), which of the following statements are true?

a
There is a local minimum at x=3
b
There is a local minimum at x=−3
c
There is a local maximum at x=3
d
There is a local maximum at x=−3
e
The function f(x) has no local extrema
